description: Source code for managing 'Packed Item' documents in ERPNext, including functions for handling product bundles, packing list creation, and database interactions.

classes.name: PackedItem
classes.description: Document class representing a packed item in ERPNext.

methods.name: get_product_bundle_items
methods.description: Fetches items belonging to a product bundle based on item code.

methods.name: get_packing_item_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a packing item given its code and company.

methods.name: get_bin_qty
methods.description: Gets actual and projected quantity of an item in a specific warehouse.

methods.name: update_packing_list_item
methods.description: Updates or adds a packing list item in the document.

methods.name: make_packing_list
methods.description: Creates a packing list for product bundle items.

methods.name: cleanup_packing_list
methods.description: Removes child items no longer present in the main item table.

methods.name: add_item_to_packing_list
methods.description: Appends a packed item to the document's packing list.

methods.name: update_product_bundle_price
methods.description: Updates prices of product bundles based on contained item rates.

methods.name: update_parent_item_price
methods.description: Updates the price of a parent item in a bundle.

methods.name: update_parent_item_rate
methods.description: Calculates and updates the rate of a parent item based on bundle price.

methods.name: get_items_from_product_bundle
methods.description: Retrieves items from a product bundle with calculated quantities.

methods.name: on_doctype_update
methods.description: Adds index to 'Packed Item' doctype for optimization.

methods.name: get_old_packed_item_details
methods.description: Creates a mapping of old packed items for comparison during updates.
